title: mtf-facts version --json
description: What this binary is and what it supports, so a script checks a minimum version and the features it needs once, with no --help parsing. A feature name, once shipped, keeps its meaning and is never removed; a script tests for membership. A binary older than this report rejects --json with exit 2.

version.description: The module version, a tag such as v0.9.0 for a release or go install of a tag, or (devel) for a local build. The same text as mtf-facts version prints.

commit.description: The commit the binary was built from, or null when the build recorded none (go install of a tag).

modified.description: Whether the work tree had changes at build time; null when commit is null.

go.description: The Go toolchain that built the binary.

reports.description: The schema_version of each JSON report that carries one, keyed by the command that writes it; stats is the record --stats-file writes, whatever the command. A report with no schema_version is not listed.

features.description: Sorted, unique. cmd:<path> per command, flag:<path>:<name> per long flag the command accepts, and <path>.<name> per behaviour or accepted value, where <path> is the command names joined by dots, such as merge.check.
